C06 and C12 share the same statutory order template but lack C10's distinctive parties and location.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"a labor dispute between the Union Carbide and Carbon Corporation and certain of its employees represented by the Atomic Trades and Labor Council, AFL, at the Oak Ridge National Laboratory","parent_excerpt":"a labor dispute between the Carbide and Carbon Chemicals Corporation and certain of its employees represented by the Atomic Trades and Labor Council, AFL, involving ... employment at the Oak Ridge National Laboratory","explanation":"The directives concern essentially the same employer-labor relationship and facility, with an updated corporate name and expanded facility description."},{"child_excerpt":"such dispute threatens to result in a strike affecting a substantial part of an industry engaged in trade or commerce among the several States or with foreign nations, or in the production of goods for commerce, which strike, if permitted to occur or to continue, will imperil the national health and safety","parent_excerpt":"such dispute threatens to result in a strike or lockout affecting a substantial part of an industry engaged in trade or commerce among the several States or with foreign nations, or in the production of goods for commerce, which strike or lock-out, if permitted to occur, will imperil the national safety","explanation":"The child closely reproduces the parent's distinctive statutory-risk recital, with limited adjustments concerning lockouts, continuation, and national health."},{"child_excerpt":"The Board shall have powers and duties as set forth in Title II of the said Act.
